title: The Galaxy Comes Alive (Formerly Avali Project)
description: Mod aimed to add content over multiple races, from avali to protogens, sergals and more..!
body:
# When The Galaxy Comes Alive

An open-source Minecraft mod that brings a diverse array of alien and furry species into your worlds. Play as Protogens, Avali, Sergals, and more.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/jtFi8f-pAtA" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

---
## About

The Galaxy Comes Alive (formerly known as the Avali Project) is an ambitious open-source Minecraft mod that aims to bring a diverse array of alien and anthropomorphic species into the overworlds.

Originally started as simple mod project to add the beloved Avali species alongside sergals and protogens, it has grown into a broader vision which is ever growing as we're working on the mod a galaxy with playable races and unique mobs. Whether you're a tech-savvy **Protogen**, a feathered explorering **Avali**, or proud **Sergal** warrior, we're trying our best to fill a gap that has never been filled and bring content and innovate.

This is a truly community-driven project. We welcome contributions of all kinds — models, textures, code, artists, or ideas. Anyone is welcome!

---

## Key Features

- **Playable Species** — Custom models, animations, able to switch from avali, sergal, protogen or expie
- **Custom Mobs** — Species-specific mobs coming from the lore, making the overworld feel more alive
- **Open Source & Community Driven** — Anyone can contribute models, textures, code, or ideas
- **Future Mod Compatibility** — Planned deep integration with **Origins** (custom powers & origins) and **TerraBlender** (unique biomes and world generation)

---

## Featured Species

### Protogen
Advanced cybernetic lifeforms with signature glowing visors. Masters of technology and exploration. Highly intelligent and adaptable.

**Status:** Playable + Mobs

### Avali
Graceful avian humanoids covered in feathers. Known for their pack mentality, agility, and adaptation to harsh environments. Excellent scouts and survivors.

**Status:** Playable + Mobs

### Sergal
Robust tribal beings blending wolf and shark features. Fierce warriors with strong communal bonds and rich cultural heritage.

**Status:** Playable + Mobs

*More species from the furry fandom are planned and will be added based on community feedback.*

---

## Planned Content

- **Origins Integration** — Full compatibility with the Origins mod. Each species will become a powerful Origin with unique abilities, dietary needs, and special traits.
- **TerraBlender Support** — Custom world generation featuring beautiful, lore-accurate biomes and structures for each species.
- **New Species Pipeline** — Regular additions based on community votes. More Protogen variants and popular furry species (manokit, felkin, wickerbeasts, yinglet, etc.) are coming soon.
- **Species Items & Gear** — Unique technology, traditional weapons, armor, and utility items themed around each species’ culture and technology.

Have an idea? Join our [Discord](https://discord.gg/6pw6MN54rn) and share it in the suggestions channel!

---

## Contributing

This project thrives on community input. Whether you're a coder, modeler, artist, writer, or just someone with great ideas — you're welcome here.

**Anyone Welcome:**
- Java developers in Neoforge
- Blockbench modelers & animators
- Texture & concept artists

**How to contribute:**
1. Join our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/6pw6MN54rn)
2. Read the `#rules` channel
3. Share your ideas, report bugs, suggest content
4. Have fun!

All contributors will be credited both in-game and on this page. This mod is also open and free, no funding will ever be asked nor wanted, passion comes from the heart, not the wallet.
